notes: B-57 (2026-10-29): 'Whenever one or more Cats you control deal combat damage to a PLAYER, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment that player controls.' Two Cats attack: the Sovereign (2/3) is unblocked and deals 2 to the opponent, the Alley Cat (1/1, 2/2 under the Sovereign) is blocked by a 0/9 wall and deals its damage only to the wall. Exactly ONE firing, from the player damage: one of the opponent's two artifacts is destroyed, the other stays. Before the fix the recipient filter was universal, so the Cat's damage to the WALL fired a second time and 'that player' (the wall's controller) lost both artifacts.
